goals.statement: Build RRuleR into a production-oriented autonomous agent runtime/control plane that can credibly compete with commercial agent SaaS for long-running autonomous work.

dimensions.target: Sustained wall-clock useful-work coverage with minimal dead time
Abrupt worker/session/scheduler/tool failures recover quickly without duplicate harmful work
Safe delegation and multi-agent coordination where beneficial
Useful work across available tools/environments with replaceable adapters
Operator can see current state, progress, failures, utilization and next action
Completion and side effects independently evidenced
Public-safe, auditable authority and security boundaries
Fresh session can reproduce/operate system with low manual setup

goals.statement: Preserve the aggregate utilization objective while the operator-locked P0-A/P0-B pair defines the immediate execution order: achieve and sustain at least 840 seconds of evidenced useful work in 900-second fixed windows without inferred unknown time.

Make every normal nonterminal CONTINUE turn sustain at least 10 minutes (600 observed elapsed seconds) of chained authorized work unless an explicit STOP/PAUSE, durable terminal state, genuine BLOCKED/fail-closed condition, or platform-enforced termination applies; maximize evidenced useful-work coverage without padding or fabricated activity.

Canary normal continuation scheduling at exactly 2 minutes (120 seconds) after actual observed END on the SAME enabled recurring MAIN, live-verify exact DTSTART plus RRULE:FREQ=HOURLY, persist identical due across durable projections, and measure provider delivery/startup separately. Historical +1 minute (60 seconds) evidence remains the comparator; do not claim +120 is superior without observed duty-cycle or authority-safety benefit.

acceptance.human_meaning: active canary is exactly 2 minutes (120 seconds) after actual observed END on the same recurring MAIN

operator_priority_lock.rule: Until both P0 goals have stable evidence and are retained as regression gates, other product/runtime expansion is secondary unless it directly improves one of these two goals or preserves required safety/correctness. The aggregate utilization goal remains a compatibility/regression objective and does not displace the ordered P0-A/P0-B execution lock.
